description.narrative: The project will be aligned with the following impact: socio-economic prosperity and resilience of society developed. It will strengthen communities capacities to improve climate resilience by applying nature-based solutions for water security and livelihoods diversification. This will be achieved by adopting a spatial cluster approach and targeting the most vulnerable watersheds and municipalities.
